data.name: Legal.Privacy.Intro
data.value: This policy explains how we collect, use and protect your personal data when you use the Booster authentication service.

data.name: Legal.Privacy.S1.Body
data.value:
This Privacy Policy covers the sign-in, registration, password reset and application authorisation screens provided by Booster (together, the “Service”). The applications you access through the Service have their own privacy policies, which also apply.

For the statutory notice on the processing of your personal data, please also see the Privacy Notice (KVKK).

data.name: Legal.Privacy.S2.Body
data.value:
• Account information: first name, last name, email address, phone number and username.
  • Authentication information: an irreversibly hashed form of your password, one-time verification codes and identifiers received from an external identity provider you link (for example, your corporate account).
  • Technical information: IP address, browser and device information, sign-in time and result.
  • Cookies: cookies that keep your session and preferences; see the Cookie Policy for details.

data.name: Legal.Privacy.S3.Body
data.value:
We use your information only to:

  • verify your identity and give you secure access to your account,
  • share with the applications you authorise only the information you approve,
  • detect and prevent unauthorised access attempts, fraud and abuse,
  • send essential account notifications (verification codes, password reset links),
  • comply with our legal obligations.

We do not use your information for advertising and we do not sell it.

data.name: Legal.Privacy.S4.Body
data.value:
We share your information only in the following cases:

  • Applications you authorise: the information clearly shown on the consent screen and approved by you.
  • Our service providers: partners bound by confidentiality who provide services such as hosting, email and SMS delivery on our behalf and under our instructions.
  • Legal requirements: lawful requests from competent authorities.

data.name: Legal.Privacy.S5.Body
data.value:
We keep your account information for as long as your account is open. When you close your account, your information is deleted or anonymised, subject to any statutory retention obligations.

Security records such as sign-in history are kept for the period required by the applicable legislation.

data.name: Legal.Privacy.S6.Body
data.value:
We apply industry-standard technical and organisational measures to protect your information: all connections are encrypted, passwords are stored irreversibly, session cookies are sent only over secure connections and access to systems is restricted on a need-to-know basis.

No system is entirely risk-free. If you notice suspicious activity on your account, please change your password and contact us.

data.name: Legal.Privacy.S7.Body
data.value: You have the right to access your personal data, to request its correction, deletion or restriction of processing, and to withdraw any consent you have given. Details of your rights and how to exercise them are set out in the Privacy Notice (KVKK).

data.name: Legal.Privacy.S8.Body
data.value:
We may update this policy from time to time. We announce material changes through the Service before they take effect; the current version is always available on this page.

If you have any questions, you can reach us at privacy@booster.example.

data.name: Legal.Terms.Intro
data.value: By using the Booster authentication service you agree to the following terms. Please read them carefully.

data.name: Legal.Terms.S1.Body
data.value:
These Terms of Use govern the use of the authentication service provided by Booster (the “Service”). By registering for or signing in to the Service, you confirm that you have read, understood and accepted these terms.

If you do not accept the terms, please do not use the Service.

data.name: Legal.Terms.S2.Body
data.value:
• You are responsible for making sure the information you provide during registration is accurate, current and complete.
  • Your account is personal; it may not be transferred to or shared with anyone else.
  • You must have the legal capacity required by applicable law to use the Service.

data.name: Legal.Terms.S3.Body
data.value:
You are responsible for keeping your password and the verification codes sent to you confidential. We recommend choosing a strong password that you do not use anywhere else. If you suspect unauthorised use of your account, change your password immediately and let us know.

Booster will never ask for your password or verification code by email, phone or message.

data.name: Legal.Terms.S4.Body
data.value:
When using the Service, you agree not to:

  • attempt to access another person's account without permission or impersonate anyone,
  • create accounts in bulk or attempt passwords using automated tools,
  • attempt to bypass or disable the Service's security measures (except security testing carried out with written permission),
  • place a load on the Service that disrupts its operation or distribute malicious software,
  • use the Service for any purpose that breaches applicable law.

data.name: Legal.Terms.S5.Body
data.value:
The Service lets you sign in to third-party applications with your Booster account. You see and approve on the consent screen which information will be shared with these applications.

Each connected application's provider is responsible for its content and its own data processing.

data.name: Legal.Terms.S6.Body
data.value:
We make reasonable efforts to provide the Service without interruption or errors; however, temporary interruptions may occur due to maintenance, updates or unforeseen technical reasons.

We may temporarily suspend or close your account in the event of a breach of these terms, a security risk or a legal requirement. Where possible, we will inform you in advance.

data.name: Legal.Terms.S7.Body
data.value: All intellectual property rights in the software, design, logos and other content of the Service belong to Booster or its licensors. These terms grant you no rights other than the right to use the Service for its intended purpose.

data.name: Legal.Terms.S8.Body
data.value: To the extent permitted by applicable law, Booster is not liable for indirect damages arising from the use of, or inability to use, the Service. Cases of intent and gross negligence, and liabilities that cannot be limited by law, are excluded from this limitation.

data.name: Legal.Terms.S9.Body
data.value:
We may update these terms when necessary. We announce material changes through the Service; continuing to use the Service after a change means that you accept the updated terms.

These terms are governed by the laws of the Republic of Türkiye. The courts and enforcement offices of Istanbul have jurisdiction over disputes; your statutory rights as a consumer are reserved.

data.name: Legal.ExplicitConsent.Intro
data.value: Information on the explicit consent you may freely give, under Turkish Personal Data Protection Law No. 6698, for the processing described below.

data.name: Legal.ExplicitConsent.S1.Body
data.value:
Processing that is necessary for the core operation of the Service relies on the legal grounds set out in the Privacy Notice (KVKK) and does not require your explicit consent. This text covers only the additional processing that depends on your explicit consent.

Giving explicit consent is optional. Not giving it does not prevent you from using the core features of the Service.

data.name: Legal.ExplicitConsent.S2.Body
data.value:
• identity and contact information (first name, last name, email address, phone number),
  • transaction and device information relating to your use of the Service,
  • usage information obtained through functional and analytics cookies.

data.name: Legal.ExplicitConsent.S3.Body
data.value:
• personalising your experience and remembering your preferences,
  • improving the Service by analysing how it is used,
  • informing you about our products and services, if you request it.

data.name: Legal.ExplicitConsent.S4.Body
data.value: Some of the providers we use for analytics and infrastructure may have servers located outside Türkiye. With your explicit consent, your personal data may be transferred to these providers, limited to the purposes above and in accordance with Article 9 of the KVKK.

data.name: Legal.ExplicitConsent.S5.Body
data.value:
You can withdraw your explicit consent at any time without giving a reason. You can withdraw consent for cookies via the “Cookie preferences” link at the bottom of the page, and any other consent by writing to kvkk@booster.example.

Withdrawal takes effect only from the moment it is made; it does not affect the lawfulness of processing carried out before then.

data.name: Legal.ExplicitConsent.S6.Body
data.value: I confirm that I have read and understood this text and that I freely give my explicit consent to the processing and transfer of the personal data described above for the stated purposes.

data.name: Legal.Kvkk.Intro
data.value: In accordance with Article 10 of Turkish Personal Data Protection Law No. 6698 (“KVKK”), we inform you, as data controller, about the processing of your personal data.

data.name: Legal.Kvkk.S1.Body
data.value: Your personal data is processed by Booster (the “Company”), as data controller, within the scope described in this notice.

data.name: Legal.Kvkk.S2.Body
data.value:
• Identity: first name, last name, username.
  • Contact: email address, phone number.
  • Customer transactions: sign-in history, permissions and consents granted to applications.
  • Transaction security: password hash, verification codes, IP address, device and browser information, session cookies.

data.name: Legal.Kvkk.S3.Body
data.value:
• carrying out membership and account operations,
  • carrying out authentication and authorisation for connected applications,
  • carrying out information security processes and preventing unauthorised access and abuse,
  • following up on requests and complaints,
  • providing information to authorised persons, institutions and organisations, and fulfilling legal obligations.

data.name: Legal.Kvkk.S4.Body
data.value:
Your personal data is collected electronically through the registration, sign-in and consent screens, cookies and any external identity providers you link.

This data is processed on the legal grounds set out in Article 5 of the KVKK: being directly related to the conclusion or performance of a contract, the data controller's compliance with a legal obligation and the data controller's legitimate interests, provided that your fundamental rights and freedoms are not harmed. Processing based on explicit consent is described separately in the Explicit Consent text.

data.name: Legal.Kvkk.S5.Body
data.value: Limited to the purposes above, your personal data may be transferred, in accordance with Articles 8 and 9 of the KVKK, to the applications you authorise (within the scope you approve), to our suppliers of hosting and message delivery services, and, upon request, to competent public authorities.

data.name: Legal.Kvkk.S6.Body
data.value:
Under Article 11 of the KVKK, as a data subject you have the right to:

  • learn whether your personal data is processed and, if so, request information about it,
  • learn the purpose of processing and whether the data is used in line with that purpose,
  • know the third parties in Türkiye or abroad to whom the data is transferred,
  • request correction of incomplete or inaccurate data, request deletion or destruction under the conditions laid down in the law, and request that these actions be notified to third parties to whom the data was transferred,
  • object to a result against you arising exclusively from analysis by automated systems,
  • claim compensation for damage suffered due to unlawful processing.

data.name: Legal.Kvkk.S7.Body
data.value:
You can submit requests regarding your rights in writing, in accordance with the Communiqué on the Procedures and Principles of Application to the Data Controller, or from the email address registered in our system to kvkk@booster.example.

Your request will be concluded free of charge within thirty days at the latest, depending on its nature.

data.name: Legal.Cookies.Intro
data.value: This policy explains which cookies we use on the Booster authentication screens, why we use them and how you can manage your preferences.

data.name: Legal.Cookies.S1.Body
data.value: Cookies are small text files that a website you visit stores in your browser. They are used for things like keeping you signed in, running security checks and remembering your preferences.

data.name: Legal.Cookies.S2.Body
data.value:
• Strictly necessary cookies: required for the Service to work; they keep your session, security checks, language choice and cookie choice. No consent is required for them and they cannot be switched off.
  • Functional cookies: make things easier by remembering preferences such as the sign-in method you last used. Used only if you allow them.
  • Analytics cookies: help us measure, in aggregate, how the screens are used so we can improve them. Used only if you allow them.

We do not use advertising or targeting cookies.

data.name: Legal.Cookies.S3.Body
data.value:
• booster_idp_session: remembers that you are signed in; kept until your session ends.
  • .AspNetCore.Antiforgery.*: blocks forged requests by verifying that forms were submitted by you; kept for the browser session.
  • accept-language: remembers the language you selected; kept for 1 year.
  • booster_cookie_consent: remembers your cookie choice; kept for 1 year.

data.name: Legal.Cookies.S4.Body
data.value:
Using the cookie bar shown on your first visit, you can accept all, reject all or set your preferences per category. You can change your decision at any time via the “Cookie preferences” link at the bottom of the page.

You can also delete or block cookies in your browser settings; however, if you block strictly necessary cookies you may not be able to sign in.

data.name: Legal.Cookies.S5.Body
data.value:
Session cookies are deleted when you close your browser or your session ends. Persistent cookies are kept for the periods stated above.

If our cookie policy changes materially, you will be asked for your choice again.

data.name: Legal.Cookies.S6.Body
data.value: If you have questions about cookies, you can reach us at privacy@booster.example. Details on the processing of your personal data are available in the Privacy Policy and the Privacy Notice (KVKK).
